summary: Unusual Machines filed an 8-K solely to disclose an amendment to its management services agreement with 8 Consulting LLC, the entity of its CEO. The amendment extends the termination date to December 31, 2026 and raises the annual service fee to $350,000, which was previously approved by the Compensation Committee. There is no transaction, no special situation—only a routine contractual modification to executive compensation. This is an ordinary current report with no deal terms, no strategic event, and no structural change warranting classification as a special situation. No further analysis is needed.
